data.title: Global chip selloff deepens as AI worries, China competition weigh
data.description: Investing.com -- Shares of U.S. and European chipmakers fell Tuesday as a selloff in AI-exposed stocks deepened, pulling the broader technology sector lower amid concerns over the sustainability of AI investment and intensifying competition.
